manifest.name: @flametinary/dsh-phone-remote
manifest.description: Open the DeepSeek Harness desktop Web UI from a phone on your LAN, over Tailscale, or through an optional Cloudflare tunnel, with an in-app settings page. Host + client DSH plugin.

bundle.text:
# DSH bundle patch. `plugin_manager install_bundle` mounts this row into the
# profile; the row id is the stable id used by the Plugins UI and by
# `plugin_manager set_plugin`.
- insert:
    - id: phone-remote
      name: "@flametinary/dsh-phone-remote"
      config: {}

readme.text:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **本插件只适用于 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端。**
>
> dsh-phone-remote 是一个 **DeepSeek Harness 插件（Host + 设置页 Client）**，它运行在 DeepSeek Harness 客户端进程内部，只把本机正在运行的 Harness Web UI 镜像到局域网。它**不是**通用反向代理，也**不是**独立网站；可选的 Cloudflare 隧道只用于把 Harness 自己的 Web UI 暴露给你自己的手机。它**不能**用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code、ChatGPT 或其他 AI 客户端。没有 DeepSeek Harness 客户端，这个插件没有任何作用。
>
> **DSH only.** This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin (Host + settings-page Client) for the **DeepSeek Harness desktop client**. It mirrors the client's own Web UI, over the LAN or (optionally) through a Cloudflare tunnel. It is not a generic reverse proxy or standalone server, and it does not work with any other AI client.

把手机或平板变成 DeepSeek Harness 的第二块屏幕：同一个局域网一个链接直连；离开局域网时，可选用 Cloudflare 命名隧道（需要账号与域名）从外网打开桌面客户端里正在进行的会话。不需要安装 App。

> 截图中的访问密钥已打码。

> 设置页入口：**插件 → 已安装插件 → 手机远程访问**。改完参数点「保存并应用」即可，网关会自动重启。

```
┌─────────────┐    LAN HTTP / WebSocket     ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  手机/平板   │ ──────────────────────────▶ │  dsh-phone-remote (58800)        │
│  浏览器      │ ◀────────────────────────── │  ├─ 访问密钥 / Basic 鉴权         │
└─────────────┘                             │  ├─ 网段白名单                    │

> 本项目是非官方社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

---

- [适用范围（先读）](#适用范围先读)
- [功能](#功能)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [使用](#使用)
- [配置](#配置)
- [安全模型（必读）](#安全模型必读)
- [移动端增强](#移动端增强)
- [命令行](#命令行)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [升级、卸载与迁移](#升级卸载与迁移)
- [开发与验证](#开发与验证)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [License](#license)

---

| 项目 | 是否支持 |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端（macOS，`0.2.1-rc.3` 实测） | ✅ |
| DeepSeek Harness 的其他版本 | ⚠️ 理论可用；宿主 API 或 Cookie 格式变化时可能需要适配 |
| 手机 / 平板浏览器（同一局域网） | ✅ |
| 手机 / 平板（外网 / 4G / 不同网络） | ✅ 推荐 Tailscale（同一 tailnet）；也可选 Cloudflare 命名隧道（需 `cloudflared`） |
| Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / VS Code / ChatGPT / 其他 AI 客户端 | ❌ 完全不适用 |
| 作为通用反向代理、静态服务器或内网穿透工具 | ❌ 不设计用于这些场景 |
| 直接公网暴露网关端口 | ❌ 请使用 Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道，不要做端口映射 |

它依赖 DeepSeek Harness 客户端的两个 Host 服务：

- `webServer`：拿到本机 Web UI 的真实监听地址；
- `credentials`（可选）：读取 `client-connection/browser-session` 凭据并为手机代签浏览器会话 Cookie。

没有这两样东西，插件无法工作。因此**请只在 DeepSeek Harness 客户端中使用它**。

---

- **一条链接进入**：`http://<电脑局域网 IP>:58800/?k=<访问密钥>`，首次打开后写入 1 年有效的网关 Cookie，之后直接访问即可。
- **完整代理 Harness Web UI**：HTTP、SSE/流式响应和 WebSocket（`/api/remote.mux`）都会转发，会话、工具调用和审批界面与桌面端一致。
- **访问密钥保护**：入口支持 `?k=` 自动登录、网关 Cookie 和可选 HTTP Basic，三种方式任选其一。
- **局域网白名单**：只接受回环地址与配置中的 IPv4 CIDR，默认根据本机网卡生成 `/24` 白名单。
- **自动代签 Harness 会话**：在客户端进程内用本机凭据为浏览器签发 30 天有效的会话 Cookie，上游返回 401 时自动换一次凭据重试。
- **外网访问（Tailscale，推荐）**：手机与电脑加入同一个 Tailscale 网络后，直接用 `http://100.x.x.x:58800/?k=...` 从 4G/5G 访问；不需要 Cloudflare 账号和域名。启用后自动放行 `100.64.0.0/10`，其它网段规则不变，访问密钥仍然必需。
- **外网访问（可选，Cloudflare）**：不在同一局域网或使用 4G/5G 时，通过 `cloudflared` 命名隧道连接（Token + 固定域名）。⚠️ Cloudflare 快速隧道不支持 SSE，Harness 会停在「加载插件…」，只适合连通性测试。局域网内仍优先直连，手机在家庭网络时会从 Cloudflare 入口 302 跳回局域网地址。
- **应用内设置页**：在插件详情页直接修改监听端口、上游端口、网段白名单、Basic 凭据、访问密钥、移动端增强与 Cloudflare 隧道；保存后自动重写 `config.json` 并重启网关。
- **随插件启停**：在 DeepSeek Harness 的插件设置里关闭插件，监听端口与隧道立即关闭；重新打开即可恢复。
- **移动端抽屉增强**：窄屏下把 Harness 自带的侧边栏变成滑出抽屉，补一个汉堡按钮，并避免 iOS 输入框自动放大。
- **局域网模式零第三方依赖**：只用 Node.js 标准库；外网模式额外依赖官方 `cloudflared` 可执行文件（不随插件捆绑）。
- **自带诊断**：仪表盘、`/__dshgw/status`、日志、`phone-url.txt`、`dsh-phone-remote status`。

1. 插件作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Host bundle 启动，在 `0.0.0.0:58800` 上创建自己的 HTTP 服务器；另外在 Harness 的 `webServer` 上注册一个仅限本机回环的配置接口 `/phone-remote/api/config`，供设置页读写配置。
2. 上游地址优先通过 `ctx.webServer.getOrigin()` 获取；失败时回退到 `ps` + `lsof` 探测 Harness Web UI 的 `127.0.0.1` 端口，结果缓存 8 秒。
3. 每个请求先做来源网段检查，再做访问密钥 / Basic 鉴权。
4. 通过鉴权后，插件读取本机 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里的 `client-connection/browser-session` secret，用 HMAC-SHA256 代签 Harness 浏览器会话 Cookie，再转发请求。
5. 对 HTML 文档请求，插件把移动端抽屉的 CSS/JS 注入到 `</body>` 前；其余资源原样透传。
6. WebSocket 升级请求在鉴权后透传到上游，双向 pipe。
7. 启用 Cloudflare 时，插件管理一个 `cloudflared` 子进程：快速隧道从输出里解析 `trycloudflare.com` 地址，命名隧道通过 `TUNNEL_TOKEN` 连接；地址变化后写回 `phone-url.txt` 并出现在状态里。注意快速隧道不支持 SSE，只能做连通性测试。
8. 请求从 Cloudflare 进来时，网关读取 `CF-Connecting-IP`，与本机公网 IP 比较；如果 `autoLanRedirect` 开启且两者相同（手机在家庭网络），302 跳到局域网链接，否则继续走 Cloudflare 代理。
9. 设置页（`client.js`）通过 `plugins.bundle.config` 槽位挂在插件详情页，调用同源接口读取/保存配置；保存后插件重建网关与隧道实例并重新监听。

除了这个仅限本机回环的配置接口，插件**不会**在 Harness Web 服务器上注册其他路由、不会修改 Harness 配置，也不会把凭据写进日志。

---

- **DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端**（本插件唯一的运行宿主），且 Web UI 正在运行。
- 电脑与手机在**同一局域网**（同一 Wi-Fi / 同一路由器下的有线与无线均可），**或者**电脑安装 `cloudflared` 后使用外网模式。
- 外网模式需要 Cloudflare 官方 `cloudflared`：macOS 可执行 `brew install cloudflared`，其他平台见 [Cloudflare 文档](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/downloads/)；并确保电脑能访问 Cloudflare。
- 端口 `58800` 未被占用（可在配置中修改）。
- 插件安装器使用客户端内置的 Node 运行时；手动运行脚本需要 Node.js ≥ 20。
- 已在 macOS 上测试；Linux/Windows 的 DSH 桌面版理论可用，但未实测。

---

readme.section: 方式 A：在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中安装（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 把本仓库克隆或下载到本机，例如：

```bash
   git clone https://github.com/FlameTinary/dsh-phone-remote.git ~/CodeRepo/dsh-phone-remote
   ```

2. 打开 DeepSeek Harness，点击侧边栏的 **「插件」**（即 设置 → 插件），选择 **「添加插件」**。
3. 在安装源中填入**本地目录的绝对路径**，例如 `/Users/sheldon/CodeRepo/dsh-phone-remote`，点击「安装」。
4. 安装完成后，在 **「已安装插件」** 中找到 **「手机远程访问」（Phone Remote）**，确认开关为开启状态。

> 从 0.1.x 升级：包名已改为 `@flametinary/dsh-phone-remote`。请先卸载旧插件，再按本节重新安装；`~/.dsh/phone-remote/` 下的配置、密钥和日志会保留。

readme.section: 方式 A：在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中安装（推荐）
readme.text: > 插件安装是「链接目录」方式：之后 `git pull` 更新代码，重启 DeepSeek Harness 即可加载新版本，无需重复安装。

readme.section: 方式 B：通过插件管理工具安装（自动化 / 远程排障）
readme.text:
在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 会话中调用 `plugin_manager`：

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "/Users/sheldon/CodeRepo/dsh-phone-remote" }
```

安装成功后用 `list_bundles` 应能看到：

```text
@flametinary/dsh-phone-remote  0.4.0  availability=profile  installed=true  enabled=true
```

启用 / 停用：

```json
{ "action": "set_bundle", "target": "@flametinary/dsh-phone-remote", "enabled": false }
```

- 创建 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/config.json`（权限 `0600`），随机生成访问密钥与 Basic 密码。
- 如果发现旧版 skill / launchd 网关的配置 `~/.dsh/remote-gateway/config.json`，会**自动迁移**其中的端口、密钥、网段等设置。
- 启动监听，并写入 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/phone-url.txt`（包含手机链接与 Basic 凭据，权限 `0600`）。

> ⚠️ 旧版 `dsh-phone-remote` skill 通过 launchd 常驻网关，会占用 `58800` 端口。安装本插件前请先停掉它：
>
> ```bash
> launchctl bootout gui/"$UID"/com.dsh.remote-gateway 2>/dev/null || true
> mv ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist \
>    ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist.disabled 2>/dev/null || true
> ```

---

任选一种：

- 在电脑上打开 **`http://127.0.0.1:58800/__dshgw/`**（需要 Basic 或访问密钥），页面会列出所有可用的手机链接；
- 读取 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/phone-url.txt`；
- 运行：

```bash
  node /path/to/dsh-phone-remote/bin/phone-remote.mjs url
  ```

输出类似：

```text
Phone URLs (same LAN, contains the access key):
  http://192.168.1.42:58800/?k=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Basic auth: dsh / xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

手机与电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi，用浏览器打开上面的链接即可。首次打开会 303 跳转到 `/` 并写入网关 Cookie；之后可直接访问 `http://192.168.1.42:58800/`。

可以把跳转后的地址保存为书签。`?k=` 只出现在第一次打开的 URL 里。

```bash
node /path/to/dsh-phone-remote/bin/phone-remote.mjs status
```

返回 JSON：`ok`、`version`、`pid`、`uptimeSeconds`、`upstream`、`listen`、`allowCidrs`、`phoneUrls`、`configPath` 等。

DeepSeek Harness → 插件 → 已安装插件 → **手机远程访问**：

- 关闭开关：网关立即停止监听，手机无法再连接；
- 打开开关：重新监听，链接与密钥不变。

打开 **插件 → 已安装插件 → 手机远程访问**，详情页会直接渲染配置面板：

- **手机入口**：当前所有可用局域网链接，可一键复制；
- **外网访问（Cloudflare）**：启用隧道、选择快速/命名模式、填 Token 与公网地址、查看连接状态和外网链接；
- **网络**：监听端口、上游端口、IPv4 网段白名单、移动端抽屉增强；
- **访问凭据**：Basic 用户名/密码、访问密钥（可显示、复制、重新生成）；
- **保存并应用**：写入 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/config.json` 并自动重启网关，不需要手动关开插件。

配置接口只监听在 Harness 自己的 `webServer` 上，且只接受本机回环地址；它要求携带 `x-phone-remote-config: 1` 的 JSON 请求，跨站请求无法通过浏览器预检。

readme.section: 6. 不在同一局域网：使用 Tailscale
readme.text:
Tailscale 是本插件最省事的外网方式：不依赖 SSE 限制、不需要域名，iPhone 用 4G/5G 也能直接打开完整 Harness。

1. Mac 和 iPhone 都安装 [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/download)，登录**同一个账号/同一个 tailnet**。
2. 确认 Mac 已连接：

```bash
   tailscale ip -4
   # 例：100.93.195.45
   ```

3. 打开 **插件 → 已安装插件 → 手机远程访问 → 外网访问（Tailscale）**，勾选「启用 Tailscale 访问」。
4. 「Tailscale 地址」留空会自动使用本机 Tailscale IP；也可以填 MagicDNS 名称（如 `sheldonmacbook-pro.tail3d21b4.ts.net`）。
5. 点「保存并应用」，复制「Tailscale 链接」；手机关掉 Wi-Fi、用 4G/5G 打开即可。

readme.section: 6. 不在同一局域网：使用 Tailscale
readme.text: > 启用后网关会自动把 `100.64.0.0/10` 加入**有效**允许网段，但不会写进你的 `allowCidrs`；关闭开关即恢复。Tailscale 入口仍受访问密钥 / Basic 保护，不会暴露到公网。

readme.section: 7. 不在同一局域网：使用 Cloudflare
readme.text:
> ⚠️ **Cloudflare 快速隧道（`trycloudflare.com`）官方不支持 SSE**（[Cloudflare 文档](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/get-started/quick-tunnels/)）。Harness 前端依赖 SSE 加载插件，走快速隧道会一直停在「加载插件…」，**不能完整使用**。要真正远程使用，请走**命名隧道**（需要 Cloudflare 账号和一个托管在 Cloudflare 的域名）。

1. 在电脑上安装 `cloudflared`：

```bash
   brew install cloudflared
   ```

Linux / Windows 见 [Cloudflare 下载页](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/downloads/)。

readme.section: 7. 不在同一局域网：使用 Cloudflare
readme.text:
2. 在 [Cloudflare Zero Trust](https://one.dash.cloudflare.com/) 创建一条**命名隧道**，在隧道的 Public Hostname 里新增一条：
   - Hostname：`dsh.example.com`（换成你的域名）
   - Service：`http://127.0.0.1:58800`
   然后复制隧道 Token。
3. 打开 **插件 → 已安装插件 → 手机远程访问 → 外网访问（Cloudflare）**，勾选「启用 Cloudflare 外网访问」。
4. 连接方式选 **命名隧道**，填入 Token 和你绑定的公网地址（如 `https://dsh.example.com`），点「保存并应用」，等待状态变为「已连接」。
5. 在「外网链接」里复制带 `?k=` 的地址（也可以点「打开」）；手机关掉 Wi-Fi、用 4G/5G 打开即可。

**快速隧道**（不需要账号）仍保留在选项里，但只适合测试网络连通性，不能加载完整的 Harness 界面；每次重启地址都会变。

readme.section: 7. 不在同一局域网：使用 Cloudflare
readme.text:
**同一局域网会自动切回**：开启 `autoLanRedirect` 后，手机在家庭网络访问 Cloudflare 地址时，网关会用 `CF-Connecting-IP` 与本机公网 IP 比较，相同就 302 跳到局域网链接。这个判断依赖公网 IP 检测，少数运营商 CGNAT / 多出口网络可能不生效；不生效时 Cloudflare 地址仍然可用。

> 命名隧道建议在 Cloudflare 侧再加一层 **Access**（邮箱/SSO）策略。本插件的访问密钥与 Basic 仍然有效，两者可以叠加。

---

推荐直接在**插件设置页**修改。配置文件位于 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/config.json`（首次启动自动生成，`0600`），高级用户也可以手动编辑。

```json
{
  "listenHost": "0.0.0.0",
  "listenPort": 58800,
  "allowCidrs": ["127.0.0.1/32", "192.168.1.0/24"],

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listenHost` | `0.0.0.0` | 网关监听地址。改成 `127.0.0.1` 后手机将无法连接；也可填本机具体局域网 IP。 |
| `listenPort` | `58800` | 网关端口。被占用时插件每 5 秒重试，不会导致客户端崩溃。 |
| `allowCidrs` | 回环 + 各网卡的 `/24` | 允许访问的 IPv4 网段。**必须包含手机所在网段**，否则返回 403。 |
| `accessKey` | 随机 32 字符 | 访问密钥，至少 16 字符。`?k=`、`dsh-gw` Cookie、仪表盘登录都用它。 |
| `basicUser` / `basicPass` | `dsh` / 随机 | 可选 HTTP Basic 凭据；密码至少 8 字符。 |
| `upstreamPort` | `null` | 上游 Harness 端口。一般留 `null` 自动发现；有多个 Harness 实例时可钉死。 |
| `uiEnhance.mobileDrawer` | `true` | 是否注入移动端抽屉增强。关掉后手机仍可用，但侧边栏体验退化为桌面布局。 |
| `logMaxBytes` | `1048576` | 日志轮转阈值；超过后轮转为 `gateway.log.1`。 |
| `tailscale.enabled` | `false` | 启用 Tailscale 访问；启用后有效允许网段自动加入 `100.64.0.0/10`（不写回 `allowCidrs`）。 |
| `tailscale.host` | `""` | 可选：Tailscale IP 或 MagicDNS 主机名；留空自动使用本机 `100.x` 接口地址。 |
| `cloudflare.enabled` | `false` | 是否启用 Cloudflare 隧道。关闭时完全不启动 `cloudflared`。 |
| `cloudflare.mode` | `"token"` | `token` 命名隧道（需账号，完整可用）；`quick` 临时地址，Cloudflare 不支持 SSE，Harness 无法完整加载。 |
| `cloudflare.token` | `""` | 命名隧道的 Tunnel Token，只保存在本机 `config.json`（`0600`）。 |
| `cloudflare.publicUrl` | `""` | 命名隧道在 Cloudflare 绑定的公网地址，例如 `https://dsh.example.com`。快速隧道忽略此项。 |
| `cloudflare.autoLanRedirect`
在设置页点「保存并应用」后网关会自动重启；手动编辑 JSON 后，仍需在插件设置里关闭再打开（或重启客户端）使其生效。

在设置页的「访问凭据」里点 **重新生成** 即可；旧链接和旧 Cookie 会立即失效，重新复制手机链接即可。

也可以手动编辑 `config.json`，删除 `accessKey` / `basicPass` 字段（下次启动会重新随机生成），再关闭/打开插件。

---

- **访问密钥 = 完整权限。** 拿到链接或 Basic 密码的人可以读取会话、发消息、触发工具调用、审批权限请求。请像保护 SSH 私钥一样保护访问密钥。
- **默认仅限局域网。** 默认白名单为本机 + 当前网卡的 `/24`。需要外网时优先用 Tailscale（只对你的 tailnet 开放）或 Cloudflare 命名隧道，**不要**把 `allowCidrs` 改成 `0.0.0.0/0`，也不要在路由器上做端口映射。两种外网方式都复用同一套访问密钥 / Basic 鉴权，不会绕过它们。
- **外网入口扩大暴露面。** Tailscale 启用后，同一 tailnet 内的设备都能访问到登录页；Cloudflare 启用后，互联网上的任何人都能访问到登录页。访问密钥 / Basic 是唯一边界。Cloudflare 建议再加 Access（邮箱、SSO）策略；不要把带 `?k=` 的链接发到公开群聊或提交到仓库。
- **公网 IP 判断是启发式。** `autoLanRedirect` 在手机与电脑处于同一公网 IP 时跳回 LAN，但 CGNAT、多出口、代理或云网络可能判断失败；失败时 Cloudflare 入口仍可用，只是没有就近直连。
- **局域网模式没有 TLS。** 局域网链接使用 HTTP/WS 明文，同一 Wi-Fi 下的其他人可能嗅探流量；Cloudflare 模式由 Cloudflare 终止 TLS，Cloudflare 到本机是回环 HTTP。不要在公共 Wi-Fi 或不可信网络启用局域网直连。
- **Cloudflare Tunnel Token 等同电脑的网络权限。** 拿到 Token 的人可以在自己的机器上接续这条隧道；请只在设置页/本机 `config.json` 中保存，不要写进脚本或聊天记录。发现泄露时在 Cloudflare 控制台轮换 Token。
- **Cookie 有效期为 30 天**，每次请求都会重新签发；凭据轮换或客户端升级后可能失效，重新打开 `?k=` 链接即可。
- **配置页同样敏感。** 能打开设置页的人可以改端口、网段和访问密钥；配置接口只接受**本机回环地址**的请求，并要求带 `x-phone-remote-config: 1` 的 JSON 请求（跨站请求会被预检拦截）；手机设置页通过网关代理访问时仍走回环。即便如此，也请只在可信设备上打开设置页。
- **配置文件含明文密钥与 Tunnel Token**，权限为 `0600`；`phone-url.txt` 同样含访问密钥与 Basic 密码，请不要提交到 Git、不要发到群聊。
- **日志不记录 Cookie 值**，但会记录请求路径、来源 IP 与错误信息；分享日志前请自行检查。
- **非官方插件

如果你只需要「电脑上自己用」，请不要启用本插件。

---

仅在视口宽度 ≤ 768px 时生效：

- 在 Harness 顶部标题行（`titleRow`）最左侧注入汉堡按钮，不额外占用一行；
- 点击汉堡时先触发 Harness 自带的「打开侧边栏」，再添加 `dsh-drawer-open` 类完成滑出动画；
- 侧边栏支持点击遮罩或「收起侧边栏」关闭；
- 窄屏下可编辑控件字号提升到 ≥ 16px，避免 iOS Safari 聚焦时自动放大页面；
- 使用 `MutationObserver` + `requestAnimationFrame` 在界面重渲染后补回按钮。

若不需要这层增强，把 `uiEnhance.mobileDrawer` 设为 `false` 即可，代理与鉴权不受影响。

---

需要本机有 Node.js ≥ 20。也可以直接用绝对路径调用仓库内的 `bin/phone-remote.mjs`。

```bash
dsh-phone-remote url       # 打印局域网链接、已配置的 Cloudflare 链接、Basic 凭据、监听地址、配置路径
dsh-phone-remote status    # 请求 /__dshgw/status，检查网关与隧道状态（含 cloudflare.publicUrl）
dsh-phone-remote config    # 打印配置文件路径
dsh-phone-remote help      # 帮助

`url` 在插件未启动时也可以运行（首次运行可能创建配置文件）。

---

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 手机打开显示 **401 登录页** | 链接里的 `?k=` 缺失或密钥已轮换。重新从 `phone-url.txt` / 仪表盘复制完整链接；或使用 Basic 登录。 |
| 手机打开显示 **403 source address not allowed** | 手机来源 IP 不在允许网段。局域网：把手机网段（如 `192.168.1.0/24`）加入配置；Tailscale（`100.x`）：在设置页启用 Tailscale 访问；Cloudflare：确认 tunnel 正常。 |
| **502 Bad Gateway** | 上游 Harness Web UI 不可达。确认桌面客户端正在运行、Web UI 已加载；可在配置中把 `upstreamPort` 钉死为实际端口。 |
| 端口 **58800 被占用 / `EADDRINUSE`** | 多半是旧 launchd 网关仍在运行。执行[安装](#安装)中的 `launchctl bootout`；或修改 `listenPort`。 |
| 设置里**看不到插件** | 确认安装源是插件根目录（含 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`），并在安装后重启客户端；查看 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/.plugin-manager/logs/` 下的安装日志。 |
| 插件显示已启用但**端口没监听** | 查看 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/gateway.log`；常见原因是端口冲突或配置 JSON 语法错误。 |
| 手机能打开页面但**一直转圈/断线** | 检查 WebSocket 是否被网络设备拦截；确认手机与电脑在同一子网且未开启 AP 隔离。 |
| 客户端升级后**登录失效** | 会话 Cookie 格式可能变化。先更新插件；临时可在手机重新打开 `?k=` 链接。 |
| **iOS 输入时页面放大** | 确认 `uiEnhance.mobileDrawer` 为 `true`；或升级到最新版本。 |
| 仪表盘能开，但**手机链接是 127.0.0.1** | `listenHost` 被设成了回环地址，或本机没有非回环 IPv4。改回 `0.0.0.0`。 |
| 外网链接显示 **1033 / tunnel not found** | `cloudflared` 没装好、路径不对，或命名隧道没有运行。先执行 `cloudflared --version`，再在设置页把 `cloudflaredPath` 指到绝对路径；查看 `~/.dsh/phone-remote/cloudflare.log`。 |
| 快速隧道地址**每次重启都

日志：`~/.dsh/phone-remote/gateway.log` 与 `cloudflare.log`（各超过 1 MB 自动轮转）。

readme.section: 从旧版 skill / launchd 网关迁移
readme.text:
旧版通过 `install.sh` 写入 `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist` 并常驻。迁移步骤：

```bash
launchctl bootout gui/"$UID"/com.dsh.remote-gateway 2>/dev/null || true
mv ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist \
   ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist.disabled 2>/dev/null || true
```

保留 `~/.dsh/remote-gateway/config.json` 即可让新插件首次启动时自动继承密钥与端口；确认迁移成功后，可自行删除旧目录。

readme.section: 2. 另开终端跑端到端冒烟测试

readme.text:
- **只支持 DeepSeek Harness**，不支持任何其他客户端或普通 Web 应用。
- 仅支持 **IPv4 CIDR** 白名单；IPv6 来源会被拒绝。
- **局域网模式没有 TLS**；Cloudflare 模式由 Cloudflare 终止 TLS。插件本身不管理证书。
- **外网模式依赖 `cloudflared`**（不随插件捆绑）。快速隧道不支持 SSE（Harness 无法完整加载），且地址每次重启都会变；固定地址与完整功能都需要命名隧道。
- **`autoLanRedirect` 是公网 IP 启发式**：CGNAT、多出口、代理网络可能判断失败，失败时仍走 Cloudflare，只是不会就近直连。
- 移动端增强依赖 Harness Web UI 的 DOM 结构（`titleRow`、`aria-label="打开侧边栏"` 等），客户端大改版后可能需要适配。
- 会话 Cookie 的签名格式依赖客户端实现；DSH 升级后若鉴权失败，需要更新插件。
- 端口占用时只重试、不自动改端口；需要手动修改 `listenPort`。
- 设置页由 Host 与 Client 两半组成：更新 `client.js` 后需要重启客户端（或卸载重装插件）才会生效；只安装 Host 部分时不会显示该页面。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This plugin only works with the DeepSeek Harness desktop client.**
>
> dsh-phone-remote is a **DeepSeek Harness plugin (Host + settings-page Client)**. It runs inside the DeepSeek Harness client process and mirrors that client's local Web UI onto your LAN. It is **not** a generic reverse proxy or a standalone website; the optional Cloudflare tunnel only exposes this client's own Web UI to your own devices. It **does not work** with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, ChatGPT, or any other AI client. Without DeepSeek Harness, this plugin does nothing.

Turn a phone or tablet into a second screen for DeepSeek Harness: one link on the same LAN, or from outside through an optional Cloudflare named tunnel (account and domain required). No app to install.

> The access key is redacted in this screenshot.

> Open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Phone Remote**. Change settings, then click **Save and apply**; the gateway restarts automatically.

```
┌─────────────┐    LAN HTTP / WebSocket     ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  Phone      │ ──────────────────────────▶ │  dsh-phone-remote (58800)        │
│  Browser    │ ◀────────────────────────── │  ├─ access key / Basic auth      │
└─────────────┘                             │  ├─ CIDR allowlist                │

> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

---

| Item | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness desktop client (macOS, tested with `0.2.1-rc.3`) | ✅ |
| Other DeepSeek Harness versions | ⚠️ Should work; may need adaptation if host APIs or cookie format change |
| Phone / tablet browser on the same LAN | ✅ |
| Phone / tablet away from home (cellular, other network) | ✅ Recommended: Tailscale (same tailnet); optionally a Cloudflare named tunnel (requires `cloudflared`) |
| Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / VS Code / ChatGPT / other AI clients | ❌ Not applicable |
| Generic reverse proxy, static server, or tunnel | ❌ Not a design goal |
| Directly exposing the gateway port to the internet | ❌ Use Tailscale or a Cloudflare tunnel; do not port-forward |

It depends on two DeepSeek Harness host services:

- `webServer` — to discover the real local Web UI origin;
- `credentials` (optional) — to read the `client-connection/browser-session` record and mint a browser session cookie for the phone.

Without them the plugin cannot work, which is why it is **DeepSeek Harness only**.

---

- **One link in**: `http://<lan-ip>:58800/?k=<access-key>`; the first visit sets a 1-year gateway cookie, then the bare origin works.
- **Full Web UI proxy**: HTTP, streaming/SSE, and WebSocket (`/api/remote.mux`) are forwarded; sessions, tool calls, and approval prompts behave like the desktop UI.
- **Access protection**: `?k=` auto-login, gateway cookie, or optional HTTP Basic.
- **LAN allowlist**: loopback plus configured IPv4 CIDRs; defaults are derived from local interfaces.
- **Automatic Harness session minting**: signs a 30-day browser session cookie in-process, retries once with a fresh credential on upstream 401.
- **Remote access (Tailscale, recommended)**: put the phone and computer on the same Tailscale network and open `http://100.x.x.x:58800/?k=...` over 4G/5G; no Cloudflare account or domain needed. Enabling it adds `100.64.0.0/10` to the effective allowlist; the access key is still required.
- **Remote access (optional, Cloudflare)**: when the phone is away or on cellular, connect through a `cloudflared` **named tunnel** (token + stable hostname). ⚠️ Quick tunnels do not support SSE, so the Harness UI cannot load; use them only for connectivity tests. LAN is still p

1. The plugin starts as a host bundle and creates its own HTTP server on `0.0.0.0:58800`; it also registers one loopback-only config endpoint, `/phone-remote/api/config`, on the Harness `webServer` for the settings page.
2. The upstream origin comes from `ctx.webServer.getOrigin()`; if that fails it falls back to `ps` + `lsof` discovery of the Harness Web UI port, cached for 8 seconds.
3. Each request is checked against the source CIDR allowlist, then authenticated by access key or Basic.
4. It reads the local `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` record `client-connection/browser-session`, mints a Harness browser-session cookie with HMAC-SHA256, and forwards the request.
5. For HTML documents it injects the mobile drawer CSS/JS before `</body>`; everything else is passed through.
6. WebSocket upgrades are authenticated and piped both ways.
7. When Cloudflare is enabled the plugin supervises a `cloudflared` child process: quick tunnels are discovered from the `trycloudflare.com` URL in its output, named tunnels connect with `TUNNEL_TOKEN`; URL changes are written back to `phone-url.txt` and the status payload. Quick tunnels do not support SSE, so they cannot load the full UI.
8. Requests arri

Apart from that loopback-only config endpoint, the plugin never registers routes on the Harness web server, never edits Harness configuration, and never logs credential values.

---

- **DeepSeek Harness desktop client** (the only supported host), with its Web UI running.
- Phone and computer on the **same LAN** (same Wi-Fi or the same router), **or** `cloudflared` installed for remote mode.
- Remote mode needs the official `cloudflared` (`brew install cloudflared` on macOS; see the [Cloudflare docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/downloads/) for other platforms) and outbound access to Cloudflare.
- Port `58800` free (configurable).
- Node.js ≥ 20 for the standalone scripts; the plugin itself uses the client's bundled runtime.
- Tested on macOS. Linux/Windows desktop builds should work but are untested.

readme.section: Option A: from DeepSeek Harness settings (recommended)
readme.text:
1. Clone the repository:

```bash
   git clone https://github.com/FlameTinary/dsh-phone-remote.git ~/CodeRepo/dsh-phone-remote
   ```

2. In DeepSeek Harness, open the sidebar **Plugins** page (Settings → Plugins) and click **Add plugin**.
3. Enter the **absolute local path** to this directory, e.g. `/Users/sheldon/CodeRepo/dsh-phone-remote`, then click **Install**.
4. Under **Installed plugins**, find **Phone Remote** and make sure its switch is on.

readme.text:

readme.section: Option B: plugin manager (automation / remote support)
readme.text:
From a DeepSeek Harness agent session:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "/Users/sheldon/CodeRepo/dsh-phone-remote" }
```

`list_bundles` should then show:

```text
@flametinary/dsh-phone-remote  0.4.0  availability=profile  installed=true  enabled=true
```

Enable or disable with:

```json
{ "action": "set_bundle", "target": "@flametinary/dsh-phone-remote", "enabled": false }
```

- Creates `~/.dsh/phone-remote/config.json` (`0600`) with a random access key and Basic password.
- If a legacy skill / launchd gateway config exists at `~/.dsh/remote-gateway/config.json`, it is **migrated automatically** (port, keys, CIDRs, and other settings).
- Starts the listener and writes `~/.dsh/phone-remote/phone-url.txt` (`0600`) with phone URLs and Basic credentials.

> ⚠️ The legacy skill ran a launchd gateway that occupies port `58800`. Stop it before enabling this plugin:
>
> ```bash
> launchctl bootout gui/"$UID"/com.dsh.remote-gateway 2>/dev/null || true
> mv ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist \
>    ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist.disabled 2>/dev/null || true
> ```

---

Any of:

- open **`http://127.0.0.1:58800/__dshgw/`** on the computer (Basic or access key required);
- read `~/.dsh/phone-remote/phone-url.txt`;
- run:

```bash
  node /path/to/dsh-phone-remote/bin/phone-remote.mjs url
  ```

Example:

```text
Phone URLs (same LAN, contains the access key):
  http://192.168.1.42:58800/?k=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Basic auth: dsh / xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi and open the link. The first visit redirects to `/` (303) and sets a gateway cookie; afterwards `http://192.168.1.42:58800/` works directly.

Bookmark the redirected URL. The `?k=` value only appears in the first URL.

```bash
node /path/to/dsh-phone-remote/bin/phone-remote.mjs status
```

Returns JSON with `ok`, `version`, `pid`, `uptimeSeconds`, `upstream`, `listen`, `allowCidrs`, `phoneUrls`, `remoteUrls`, `cloudflare`, `configPath`.

The config endpoint lives on the Harness `webServer` and accepts only loopback connections. It requires a JSON request with the `x-phone-remote-config: 1` header, so cross-site requests fail the browser preflight.

Tailscale is the simplest remote option: no SSE limitation, no domain, and the full Harness loads over cellular.

1. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/download) on the Mac and the iPhone, and sign in to the **same account/tailnet**.
2. Confirm the Mac is connected:

```bash
   tailscale ip -4
   # e.g. 100.93.195.45
   ```

3. Open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Phone Remote → Remote access (Tailscale)** and tick **Enable Tailscale access**.
4. Leave **Tailscale address** empty to use the local Tailscale IP, or enter a MagicDNS name such as `sheldonmacbook-pro.tail3d21b4.ts.net`.
5. Click **Save and apply**, copy the **Tailscale link**, then open it on the phone over cellular.

> Enabling adds `100.64.0.0/10` to the **effective** allowlist without writing it into `allowCidrs`; turning the toggle off removes it again. The Tailscale entry is still protected by the access key / Basic auth and is not exposed to the public internet.

> ⚠️ **Cloudflare Quick Tunnels do not support SSE** ([Cloudflare docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/get-started/quick-tunnels/)). The Harness UI uses SSE to load its plugin graph, so a quick tunnel leaves it stuck at “Loading plugins…”. **Use a named tunnel** (Cloudflare account + a domain on Cloudflare) for real remote use.

1. Install `cloudflared` on the computer:

```bash
   brew install cloudflared
   ```
Linux/Windows: see the [Cloudflare downloads page](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/downloads/).

2. In [Cloudflare Zero Trust](https://one.dash.cloudflare.com/) create a **named tunnel** and add a Public Hostname:
   - Hostname: `dsh.example.com` (your domain)
   - Service: `http://127.0.0.1:58800`
   Copy the tunnel token.
3. Open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Phone Remote → Remote access (Cloudflare)** and tick **Enable Cloudflare remote access**.
4. Choose **Named tunnel**, paste the token and your public URL (for example `https://dsh.example.com`), then click **Save and apply** and wait for **Connected**.
5. Copy the public link (it contains `?k=`) from **Public link**, or press **Open**; turn off Wi-Fi on the phone and open it over cellular.
**Quick tunnel** (no account) remains selectable for connectivity tests, but it cannot load the full Harness UI, and its URL changes on every restart.

**Back to LAN automatically**: with `autoLanRedirect` on, a phone on the home network hits the Cloudflare URL, the gateway compares `CF-Connecting-IP` with the computer's public IP, and redirects to the LAN link when they match. This is a heuristic: CGNAT, multiple egresses, or proxied networks can defeat it; the Cloudflare URL still works when it does.

> For a named tunnel, add a **Cloudflare Access** policy (email/SSO) as well. The plugin's access key and Basic auth stack on top of it.

---

Use the **plugin settings page** for normal changes. The file is `~/.dsh/phone-remote/config.json` (created on first start, mode `0600`); advanced users can still edit it by hand.

```json
{
  "listenHost": "0.0.0.0",
  "listenPort": 58800,
  "allowCidrs": ["127.0.0.1/32", "192.168.1.0/24"],

| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listenHost` | `0.0.0.0` | Bind address. Loopback makes the phone unreachable. |
| `listenPort` | `58800` | Gateway port. On conflict the plugin retries every 5 s instead of crashing. |
| `allowCidrs` | loopback + each NIC's `/24` | Allowed IPv4 CIDRs. **Must include the phone's subnet**, otherwise 403. |
| `accessKey` | random 32 chars | Access key (≥ 16 chars). Used by `?k=`, the `dsh-gw` cookie, and the dashboard. |
| `basicUser` / `basicPass` | `dsh` / random | Optional HTTP Basic credentials (password ≥ 8 chars). |
| `upstreamPort` | `null` | Pin the Harness UI port. Leave `null` for automatic discovery. |
| `uiEnhance.mobileDrawer` | `true` | Inject the mobile drawer enhancement. |
| `logMaxBytes` | `1048576` | Log rotation threshold; rotates to `gateway.log.1`. |
| `tailscale.enabled` | `false` | Enable Tailscale access; the effective allowlist gains `100.64.0.0/10` without being written back to `allowCidrs`. |
| `tailscale.host` | `""` | Optional Tailscale IP or MagicDNS name; empty auto-detects the local `100.x` interface. |
| `cloudflare.enabled` | `false` | Start the Cloudflare tunnel. When off, `cloudflared` is nev
Saving on the settings page restarts the gateway automatically. After editing the JSON by hand, toggle the plugin off/on (or restart the client).

Click **Regenerate** under Access credentials on the settings page. Old links and cookies stop working immediately; copy the new phone link.

You can also edit `config.json`: delete `accessKey` / `basicPass` (new random values are generated on start), then toggle the plugin off/on.

---
The plugin exposes **full control of the DeepSeek Harness client** to any authenticated device.

- **The access key is full access.** Anyone with the link or Basic password can read sessions, send messages, trigger tool calls, and approve permission requests. Protect it like an SSH key.
- **LAN by default.** The default allowlist is loopback plus the current `/24`. For remote access use the built-in Cloudflare tunnel — do not set `allowCidrs` to `0.0.0.0/0` and do not port-forward on your router. The tunnel reuses the same access-key / Basic checks; it does not bypass them.
- **The public entry widens the attack surface.** Once Cloudflare is enabled, anyone on the internet can reach the login page; the access key / Basic auth is the boundary. Add a Cloudflare Access policy (email, Google, GitHub, SSO) as well, and never post links containing `?k=` publicly or commit them.
- **Public-IP detection is a heuristic.** `autoLanRedirect` only redirects when the phone and computer share a public IP; CGNAT, multiple egresses, proxies, or cloud networks can defeat it. When it fails the Cloudflare entry still works, just without the LAN shortcut.
- **No TLS on LAN.** LAN links use plain HTTP/WS and can be sniffed on the same Wi-Fi. In Cloudflare mode TLS terminates at Cloudflare, and Clo

If you only use DeepSeek Harness on this computer, leave the plugin disabled.

---

Set `uiEnhance.mobileDrawer` to `false` to disable; proxying and auth are unaffected.

---

Requires Node.js ≥ 20 (or call `bin/phone-remote.mjs` directly).

```bash
dsh-phone-remote url       # LAN + configured Cloudflare URLs, Basic credentials, listen address, config path
dsh-phone-remote status    # query /__dshgw/status (includes cloudflare.publicUrl)
dsh-phone-remote config    # print the config path
dsh-phone-remote help

`url` works even when the plugin is not running (it may create the config on first use).

| Symptom | Cause / fix |
| --- | --- |
| **401 login page** on the phone | Missing/rotated `?k=`. Copy the full link again from `phone-url.txt` or the dashboard; or use Basic. |
| **403 source address not allowed** | Phone subnet missing from `allowCidrs`. Add it (e.g. `192.168.1.0/24`) and restart the plugin. |
| **502 Bad Gateway** | Harness UI unreachable. Make sure the desktop client is running; optionally pin `upstreamPort`. |
| Port **58800 in use / `EADDRINUSE`** | Usually the legacy launchd gateway. Run the `launchctl bootout` command above, or change `listenPort`. |
| Plugin **missing from settings** | Install the directory that contains `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`, then restart the client; check `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/.plugin-manager/logs/`. |
| Enabled but **nothing listening** | Check `~/.dsh/phone-remote/gateway.log`; common causes are port conflicts or invalid JSON config. |
| Page loads but **keeps disconnecting** | A network device may be blocking WebSocket, or AP isolation is on. |
| **Login breaks after a client upgrade** | Cookie format may have changed. Update the plugin; temporarily reopen the `?k=` link. |
| **iOS zooms on input focus** | Confir

readme.section: Migrating from the legacy skill / launchd gateway
readme.text:
```bash
launchctl bootout gui/"$UID"/com.dsh.remote-gateway 2>/dev/null || true
mv ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist \
   ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dsh.remote-gateway.plist.disabled 2>/dev/null || true
```

Keep `~/.dsh/remote-gateway/config.json` so the new plugin can inherit its keys and port on first start; delete the old directory afterwards if you like.

readme.section: 2. In another terminal, run the end-to-end smoke test

readme.text:
- **DeepSeek Harness only**; no other clients or generic web apps.
- IPv4 CIDRs only; IPv6 peers are rejected.
- **No TLS on LAN**; Cloudflare mode terminates TLS at Cloudflare. The plugin does not manage certificates.
- **Remote mode depends on `cloudflared`** (not bundled). Quick tunnels do not support SSE (the full UI cannot load) and their URL changes on every restart; a stable URL and the full app need a named tunnel.
- **`autoLanRedirect` is a public-IP heuristic**: CGNAT, multiple egresses, or proxies can defeat it; traffic then stays on Cloudflare rather than using the LAN shortcut.
- The mobile enhancement depends on the Harness DOM structure (`titleRow`, `aria-label="打开侧边栏"`, …) and may need adaptation after major client UI changes.
- Session cookie signing depends on the client implementation; a DSH upgrade may require a plugin update.
- On port conflict the plugin retries but does not auto-pick another port.
- The settings page needs both halves (Host + Client): after editing `client.js`, uninstall and reinstall the plugin to pick it up. A Host-only install will not show the page.
